title: AOSS Import Row
description: Normalized representation of a single CSV row from the Import Engine. This schema represents an already-parsed row (after raw CSV → structured row, before full Product mapping).

rowId.description: Unique identifier for this row within the import batch

originalRowNumber.description: Line number in the original CSV file (1-indexed)

styleCode.description: Product style code from supplier data

brand.description: Brand name as provided by supplier

raw.description: Snapshot of the original supplier fields (column name → value)

normalizedGender.description: Gender value normalized to AOSS standard (e.g., 'MEN', 'WOMEN', 'UNISEX')

normalizedCategory.description: Category value normalized to AOSS standard (e.g., 'FOOTWEAR', 'APPAREL')

normalizedSizeScale.description: Size scale normalized to AOSS standard (e.g., 'MENS_US', 'WOMENS_US')

notes.description: Optional notes or comments about this import row
